notes.title: Patch 1.04
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=35EukE49-A8;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Here's what's new in Popup Dungeon's 1.04 patch![/i]

[b]New logic available for abilities.[/b]
[list][*] Summon Character Action: Like the Summon Action, but it uses Character Data instead of Enemy Data for its summons.
[*] Transform Into Character Action: Like the Transform Action, but it uses Character Data instead of Enemy Data for its transformation.
[*] Flavor Text: Allows you to place custom text that will appear in the ability’s logic text area.
[/list]
[b]Two new search modes[/b]
[list][*] Popular: Sort by most likes all time.
[*] Recently Updated: Sort by last update time.
[/list]
[b]Game[/b]
[list][*] Added option to clear the save progress for a given game. This can be found at the bottom of the main UI tab when editing a game.
[*] Games with complex campaign hierarchies that use persisted flags to check if campaigns are unlocked should now function properly.
[/list]
[b]Game Nodes[/b]
[list][*] Enemy Encounter Data Modification: Can now accept an Enemy Pack instead of just a single enemy.
[*] Upgrade Party Equipment Reward: Can now upgrade quality instead of rank.
[/list]
[b]Content Manager[/b]
[list][*] Dependency Scan has been sped up.
[*] Should now function properly when switching between save profiles.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*] Fixed a rare bug which occurred when selecting an audio reference that was missing waveform data.
[/list]

[i]Happy adventuring![/i]

notes.title: New Patch!
notes.notes:
It's been a while, but a new patch for Popup is now live! It features quality of life improvements, new modifications for game development, and tons of fixes. 

[previewyoutube=bLIdD69UQNM;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Here's the patch notes:[/b]

[h2]Workshop Search Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added “Liked” query type which allows searching through all content you have previously liked.
[*] Search text now handles creator names and mature content flags.
[*] “Liked Creators” query type now uses your actual Steam data instead of local data to retrieve creators you have liked.
[*] Added option to view content from creators you have previously disliked.
[/list]
[h2]Game Creation[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added 2 new modification types to the Modifier node.                    
[*] Disable Equipment Drops: Enemies will no longer drop equipment.
[*] Disable Level Up Rewards: Level Up books will no longer be given at the end of a level.
[/list]
[h2]Content Management[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved logic used to detect content which is safely deletable. Specifically, items that were recursively referencing themselves can now be deleted so long as nothing outside their dependency chain references them.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug which had longer Steam Workshop descriptions being cut off.
[*] Fixed a bug that would crash the game when a recursive charm cycle involved a summon charming its owner.
[*] Fixed inconsistencies with Toggle AI control on summons that were transformed. In general, Toggle AI and the “Control Enemies” dev control should respond more consistently across various charm / summon scenarios.
[*] Fixed several bugs across numerous campaigns.
[/list]

If you have any questions, come ask on [url=https://discord.gg/ejbzcx2Jd8]Discord.[/url]

There's just a week left on our new [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/triplebtitles/aces-and-adventures]Kickstarter for Aces and Adventures.[/url] We're pushing for the procedural-mode stretch goal, and we'd really appreciate your support!

notes.title: Popup Dungeon - Dev Stream
notes.notes:
Popup Dungeon has recently released a free Halloween expansion with a new campaign, characters, enemies, equipment, and music by rad 80s rock band, Thor!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/031/105/746/21b3ceb88f1d25573e617c6c3e2e0544_original.png?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1603315312&auto=format&frame=1&lossless=true&s=6a3b66972335d221b5867154159a979d[/img]

Join the developer, Enrique, as he trick-or-treats through the neighborhood using an old-school, Might-and-Magic-style navigation system unique to this new campaign (Go North, East, South, West). 

Will he survive Samhain's curse that's turned trick-or-treaters' costumes into reality? The campaign is set to [b]hardcore[/b] mode, so watch him die... live!

notes.title: Popup Dungeon’s Update 1.01: Halloween!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Popup Adventurers!

It is time for Popup Dungeon’s Free Halloween Expansion!

[list]
[*] Content
[list]
[*] New Halloween themed campaign.
[*] New Halloween themed characters, enemies, equipment, and media.
[*] New unique charm rewarded for completing Halloween campaign.
[/list]
[*] Game Creation
[list]
[*] Added advanced filtering logic to entity filters. Allows filtering by things like active status effects, hp ratios, statistics, surrounding entities, etc.
[*] AbilityActivationTrigger: Can now use affected targets as event targets.
[*] Game Graph Editor can now scale up to 2x
[*] AbilityActivationTrigger & AbilityActionActedTrigger: Can now restrict triggering based on relative positioning between activator and target.
[*] AbilityActionActedTrigger: Can now set the value of a flag equal to the power of action which triggered the event.
[*] AbilityActionFX: Can now derive power from the value of a flag.
[*] Companion rewards and entities added to combat through CombatFx can now be set to be controlled by AI.
[*] Equipment Rewards now scale quality to better match target reward size.
[*] Presets have now transitioned to using the referenced sub graph system.
[*] Added “Set Flag Value To Filtered Entity Count” FX type to CombatFX node.
[/list]
[*] Improvements
[list]
[*] Optimized game’s launch speed which could become sluggish when multiple thousands of UGC items are installed.
[/list]
[*] Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed bug which occurred when a transformation effect was removed from an entity by the same ability that also launched it.
[*] Fixed bug which occurred when a self action was placed under a “number of targets” condition
[*] Fixed a few bugs concerning the Event Graph Registration modification.
[/list]
[/list]
[previewyoutube=zhKbihn4Yg8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Popup Dungeon’s Free Halloween Expansion!!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Popup Adventurers!

It is time for Popup Dungeon’s Free Halloween Expansion!

You find yourself on the far end of your neighborhood on a cursed night in which trick-or-treaters’ costumes have become reality. You must find your way home and discover the source of the evil.

Play through a new unique campaign complete with the following: 

[list]
[*] New Characters:
[list]
[*] Rob the Zombie
[*] Ortho the Bone Doctor (Skeleton)
[/list]
[*] New Enemies
[list]
[*] Samhain, Pumpkin-Mimic, Treant, Mushgloom, Merman, and more…
[/list]
[*] New Gear
[list]
[*] Varied
[/list]
[*] New Campaign (Unlocked by default)
[list]
[*] The players find themselves on the far end of their neighborhood on a cursed night in which trick-or-treaters’ costumes have become reality. They must find their way home and discover the source of the evil.
[*] Non-linear, open-world – Old-school Might-and-Magic-style exploration (travel North, East, South, or West from node to node – a journey through the arcade, sewers, neighbors’ houses, haunted forests, graveyards, and more)

So come on, come out, go treat-or-treatin’, and survive the night! You’re not afraid of a fight, aren’t you?

You can watch the whole Halloween trailer here!

notes.title: Popup Dungeon Update 1.005
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Game Creation[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjust Party Members Modification: Can now target by party slot.
[*] Random Node: Fixed bug with no repeat logic. Added additional settings for no repeat logic.
[*] Node text should no longer be able to spill outside of the description area on the game table.
[*] Added Comment node. The comment node is excluded from the generated graph used for gameplay, but can be used to help document your games.
[*] Added Set Difficulty Override modification type. Allows you to set difficulty exactly, ignoring all other settings.
[*] Remove Entity combat fx can now be used during the deployment phase.
[*] Added option to hide automated description from level nodes.
[*] Custom encounters can now be set to match entity ranks exactly as listed. Ignoring party size and current difficulty.
[*] Added disable charm necklace modification.
[*] Added force immediate encounter modification. Ensures encounters are triggered at start of level.
[*] Sub graphs with 0 nodes are now properly flattened.
[*] Loop nodes can now disable false output.
[*] Optimized performance of warp nodes which have exactly one exit for a given tag.
[*] Game node images can now be taken from the full screen image library.
[*] Connection order (vertical) of nodes should now be maintained correctly when the game graph is being generated and sub graphs are being flattened.
[/list]
[h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Upped maximum duration for ability actions to 10.
[/list]
[h3][b]Bug fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Corrupted content reference files will no longer cause the game to fail.
[/list]

notes.title: Introducing the Popup Dungeon Game Jam!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Adventurers! 

Welcome to the Popup Dungeon Game Jam! To enter your team, please fill out this form below. You may begin the creation of your game right away!
This event is thanks to community members Edrobot and rabbit of indifference! 
If you do not know what a Game Jam is, you and up to 2 friends must work together to create a Popup Dungeon game from start to finish within a week's time.  

[b]Entry form:[/b] [url=https://forms.gle/LTDptKA88Cd1BQYJA]https://forms.gle/LTDptKA88Cd1BQYJA[/url]

The guidelines for the contest will be as follows:

[list]
[*] No sexually explicit content.
[*] You can join at any time this week but your deadline will be the same as everyone else (October 2nd, 12 am CT.)
[*] You are not allowed to submit a game that was made before the contest begins.
[*] A maximum team size of 3.
[*] You are not allowed to use art assets from other properties (e.g. video game sprites, concept art).
[*] Your[b] game MUST be submitted[/b] before the deadline of October 2nd, 12 am CT to this form: [url=https://forms.gle/tewHaUcChZeF74W78 ]https://forms.gle/tewHaUcChZeF74W78 [/url]
[/list]
Voting will work as follows:

[list]
[*] Shortly after the development period has ended, a 48-hour voting period will begin.
[*] Voting will be done on a Google Sheets form and will be available to anyone on the [url=https://discord.gg/popupdungeon]Pop Up Dungeon discord server. [/url]
[*] If you participated in the game jam, you may not vote for your own game.
[*] Awards:
[list]
[*] [b]Jammer’s Choice:[/b] Decided by the other game jam participants.
[*] [b]Dev’s Choice:[/b] Decided by members of Triple B. Titles, developers of Pop-Up Dungeon.
[*] [b]Grand Prize:[/b] Decided by overall vote count.
[/list]
[*] Prizes for the team:
[list]
[*] [b]Jammer’s Choice: [/b]3 codes of Popup Dungeon.
[*][b] Dev’s Choice: [/b]Design a custom skin art for your character with the game's developer.
[*] [b]Grand Prize:[/b] 3 codes of Popup Dungeon, soundtracks of Popup Dungeon, early supporters’ exclusive digital artbook and a Discord tag for your bragging rights.
[/list]
[/list]

Good luck adventurers and we can not wait to see what you can do!

notes.title: Popup Dungeon Update 1.0043
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Balance[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Tweaked balance of Aim vs Cover and Focus vs Reflexes to curb chances of a target becoming nearly invulnerable. The stats no longer completely cancel each other out, instead the proportion of the two determines the result.
[*] Increased cost of hostile transformations to be in line with recent hostile status cost increase.
[/list]
[h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved steam workshop searches to not reset queries as often in response to search text changes or install status changes. Search text now uses fuzzy matching.
[/list]
[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug which could cause failure to launch back into a run when a invalid buff was left on a party member between levels.
[/list]

notes.title: Popup Dungeon Update: 1.0042
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Features[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Show Image node subtitles can now use parsed text.
[*] Added equipment rank punish type to punishment node.
[*] Added prop destruction event trigger for event dialogue graphs.
[/list]

[h3][b]Balance Changes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Armor penetration reworked to allow a percentage of an action’s power through the target’s defenses. The percentage is based on the ratio of armor penetration to defenses.
[*] Increased cost of armor penetration slightly
[*] Increased cost of hostile status effects.
[*] Increased cost of burden (transfer damage).
[*] Very Sudden Death now gives party members a critical chance buff.
[/list]

[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where a launch and summon action on the same ability could cause entities to end up on the same tile.
[*] Fixed bug which caused game node presets to not load properly if the content they depended on was deleted.
[*] Fixed bug that occurred when a game Show Image node had no image set.
[/list]

[h3][b]Upcoming changes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] We will be deprecating game node presets in the near future. Please transition any presets you wish to keep to the referenced sub graph system.
Presets are being deprecated since they do not play nicely with the content manager system, and are basically redundant with referenced subgraphs.
[/list]

notes.title: Popup Dungeon Update 1.0041
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Balance[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Party’s starting equipment rank is now based on Charm Necklace level.
[list]
[*] Emerald = Uncommon, Sapphire = Rare, Alexandrite = Epic, Diamond = Legendary
[/list]
[*] Critical Chance and Evasion multipliers now have diminishing returns for values over 100%
[list]
[*] Extremely high values are the most affected.
[/list]
[*] Increased cost of imbue damage slightly.
[list]
[*] Added diminishing returns for imbued damage over 100% (This is based on all imbued damage buffs on an entity)
[list]
[*] Extremely high values are the most affected.
[/list] [/list]
[*] Increased cost of Kill, Damage Percentage, and Heal Percentage actions slightly.
[*] Reduced evasion amount for high end ascension scaling slightly.
[*] Reduced difficulty curve multiplier for high difficulty settings.
[/list]
[h3][b]Content[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new unique charm (gold rarity)
[*] Added Dual Stat charms. Can be crafted by combining corresponding stats. (Currently 7 dual stat charms exist but this will likely continue to grow)
[/list]
[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed AI bug which would incorrectly value overriding fields/traps.
[*] Fixed bug when attempting to loop directly back into a challenge node upon failure.
[/list]

notes.title: Popup Dungeon Update 1.0032
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Features[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Save Profiles
[list]
[*] Up to 50 profiles
[*] Each profile has its own User Generated Content folder
[*] Can set login and logout passwords per profile via security questions
[*] Can switch profiles via the Options Menu in the new Profiles tab
[*] Can switch profiles during a run or from main menu
[/list]
[*] Improved backup save system to further reduce chance of corrupted saves
[*] Added now global parsed variables for game creation.
[list]
[*] {g:difficulty} (Parsed to the name of current difficulty)
[*] {g:difficulty#} (Parsed to the number of current difficulty)
[/list]
[/list]
[h3][b]Balance[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Base health increased from 100 to 200
[list]
[*] Increased cost of Kill, Damage Percentage, and -Heal Percentage actions to compensate.
[/list]
[*] Added a limit of 30 AP for ability activations per round per entity.
[list]
[*] To help prevent the possibility of infinite activation chains.
[/list]
[/list]
[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug which allowed “give ability” actions that were on delay to give abilities to an entity that was already at max ability count.
[*] Fixed bug which could hard lock the game when an entity had extremely high levels of Haste.
[*] Fixed bug which caused soft lock of the game when a field or trap had a levitate action on it.
[/list]
[h3][b]Game[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Run Home has received several improvements and modifications.
[*] The Endless Run now has starting point options.
[*] The ending portion of the Top 10 run has been shortened slightly. 
[*] Multiple fixes to the Sweetwater Campaign.
[*] Minor rebalances of certain enemies.
[/list]

notes.title: Popup Dungeon Update 1.0021
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Features[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Ability Inspection feature. Right click on an ability card to be able to get information about all its individual components.
[*] Characters uploaded to the workshop which have custom audio clips assigned to the Select or Start cues will now have the first set audio clip play when they are inspected during workshop character searches.
[*] Added ability to position entity to left of, or right of, the target for combat fx node add entity actions.
[/list]
[h3][b]Balance[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced effectiveness of self Add AP actions.
[*] Increased power cost of Give Ability actions which gave abilities with limited uses.
[*] Made low end ascension scaling lean a bit more towards defensive statistics to make combat less fiery.
[*] The Mimic action can now target self.
[*] Increased default deployment distance from 5 to 6.
[*] Deployment now uses the levitation graph instead of movement graph for calculating its spread from the party leader. This means that deployment will no longer be blocked by impassable tiles (i.e. holes, water, lava, etc).
[*] Tactician’s Charm now additionally forces initiative rolls for enemies to be 1, and initiative rolls for party members to be 10.
[*] Berserker Enemy Roll has been modified to be a bit more balanced.
[/list]
[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]  Fixed bug which could cause screen to go blank when a charged ability was beginning to be charged.
[*]  Fixed bug which could occur when an entity died as a result of being pushed off a trap and was immediately resurrected by the Sweetwater charm.
[*]  Fixed bug which could cause exploration to unsync from character.
[*]  Removed multithreading from logic used to generate equipment meshes in hopes that it will fix the load state hang certain users have experienced while doing content searches.
[/list]
[h3][b]UI[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]  Added ability for the reflected UI system to display tooltips for enumerations.
[*]  Added tooltips for Statistics and Statuses in creation UIs.
[*]  We will continue to add more tooltips to enumerations used in creation UIs.
[*]  Added a few simple context sensitive tips to the game graph editor.
[*]  Added several new game node tutorial videos.
[*]  Added new character creation tutorial video.
[*]  Added tooltips for ability upgrade books.
[/list]
[h3][b]Game[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]  Improved Run Home upgrade interfaces
[*]  Unlock downloadable Gooliette character by keeping her alive until the end of the Run Home campaign.
[*]  Improved Tutorial
[*]  Wizards Tower: Items of Power are no longer consumed when used.
[*]  Improved the Ensign Ricky character
[*]  Added new items
[*]  Retuned various enemies and abilities
[/list]

notes.title: The Future of Popup Dungeon
notes.notes:
Hail, Popup Adventurers!

The support and community feedback that we’ve received since our release on August 12th has been amazing! We’re continuing to fix bugs, and improve gameplay and usability. But soon, we’ll be ready to move on to new content. We’ve prepared a list of your suggested features that may be added to Popup Dungeon in the near future:

Gameplay and Mechanics Features:
[list]
[*] Additional Game Mechanics - We are planning to expand on the already extensive ability creation with new mechanics like combo points.
[*] New Charms - Expand your charm collection with all-new unique charms and dual statistic charms to help customize each of your runs.
[*] Additional Story-Driven Campaigns - New quests and challenges for your party of adventurers to face and all-new stories to unfold.
[*] Sticker Manager - An option to disable or enable stickers that appear on the loading screen doors.

[/list]
Added Creation Features:
[list]
[*] Creator Dashboard - A creator’s hub where you can manage all your uploaded characters, maps, campaigns, etc. See how many times other adventurers downloaded and upvoted your creations.
[*] Custom Interactable Props - Create your own in-level interactable! It could be anything from townspeople with simple dialogue to mercenary boards and resurrection shrines. Similar to enemy creation, you can import an image to act as the cutout to represent the prop, then control where and how often it will appear.
[*] Additional Tile Sets (Cyberpunk / Underwater / Ice and Snow) - To help you conjure an immersive environment, we’ll provide new tilesets for the specific world you have in mind.
[*] Tabletop Props - Spice up your favorite Popup adventurer! These new cosmetic rewards could be a variety of objects that surround the game board. Dress your created characters in cute hats!

[/list]
Multiple Profiles and Saved Data
[list]
[*] Save Profiles - Maintain multiple save files on the same computer to support more than one user.
[*] Cloud Saves - Transfer your save files between systems using Steam’s cloud save system.
[/list]

As you can see there’s lots to choose from, and we may not have time to complete it all, so we’d like your help in choosing what to prioritize.

If you accept this quest, join us on [url=https://discord.gg/popupdungeon]Discord[/url] and choose the features that interest you most! There’s a great community there ready to answer your questions!

We look forward to meeting you there! 

[url=https://discord.gg/popupdungeon][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31791200/485febe1bb0cf5c01eae3a779344c0ae167fdfd5.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Popup Dungeon Update 1.0011
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Features[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Automated Backup Save system. Should hopefully protect against potential corruption of save files.
[*] Added “Ability Pointer Over Scale” option. Determines the size of ability cards when the mouse is over them. Can be found in the Game tab of the Options Menu under the User Interface category.
[/list]
[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug which caused the game to lock when all party members were defeated in Hardcore mode.
[*] Fixed bug which occurred when the campaigns in a game graph had recursive connections.
[*] Fixed bug which occurred when a summon was killed while Sweetwater Charm and Summoner’s Charm were equipped.
[*] Added debugging logic to help track down the cause of cases where content searches fail to properly close.
[/list]
[h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Ascension Scaling for high-end difficulty now maps a larger percentage of additional potency into the Evasion statistic. We will continue to tune this to get the pacing of the high end to feel right. 
[/list]
[h3][b]UI[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added several tooltips throughout creation interfaces.
[*] Added more tutorial videos for game creation nodes.
[/list]

notes.title: Popup Dungeon is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
The time to celebrate is finally here, Adventurers!

After a 7-year development journey, the day has finally come to launch Popup Dungeon, this is a huge moment for us and the community!

Popup Dungeon is only just starting though, we will still have loads of content to give you all in the future. Not forgetting the huge amount of community content that is also quickly growing!

notes.title: Play the Popup Dungeon Demo Now for Free
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31791200/2f32a5f8c1bf0af67ecc7c1c73c2e690e2256a37.jpg[/img]


Attention Adventurers!

The PopupDungeon [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/349730/Popup_Dungeon/]Demo is now live[/url][/b]!

Download it now on Steam and get a taste of what's to come when it's released this August!

[h3]About the game[/h3]
Popup Dungeon is a  papercraft roguelike RPG that lets you create any weapon, ability, enemy, hero, and game imaginable.  

In this demo, you will experience the tutorials, Sweetwater campaign, many of the characters (there are still a lot more), teasers of Runs, and the 2nd campaign. You will also be able to use three charms in the demo instead of 5 that come with the full game. Although the demo does not include user-generated content (Also known us player creation tools), there is a lot for you to explore, so download now and see for yourself. 

We are excited for you to play the demo now and the full game later this August!
